title: Vault Community Edition and Vault Enterprise did not apply explicit ACL policy deny rules to letter case variants of…
description: Vault Community Edition and Vault Enterprise versions prior to 2.2.2, 1.21.14, and 1.19.25 did not correctly apply explicit ACL deny rules to letter case variants of user and group names in certain authentication methods. This flaw could allow an authenticated user with delegated permissions to modify protected users or groups, potentially leading to privilege escalation. The issue has been fixed in the specified patched versions.
